subject: CALL statement
notes: RE-VERIFIED (kb/Work PB962 + PB965). GR4 - `cite.py --check 14.9.4.4 "If a RETURNING phrase is specified, the result of the activated program is placed into identifier-3."` -> OK, General rules 4; §14.6.5 ("is the content of the data item referenced by that RETURNING phrase") says WHAT is placed. The row's previous CONFORMS was wrong in three ways, each measured: (1) an image-carried fixed-point returning item's text was RE-PARSED as a C# number and a content that was not a digit run (spaces) ABORTED the run unit with EC-PROGRAM-ARG-MISMATCH although the pair conformed (§14.8.3.3); (2) a native value delivered into an image-carried receiver as its C# text, so -12.5 in PIC S9(3)V9 arrived as +12.5 (012E for 012N); (3) the double leg the row claimed did not exist - a USAGE FLOAT-LONG returning item did not compile (CS0315). A fixed group returning into a variable-length receiver (and the reverse), which §14.8.3.2 admits, also aborted. Now: the returning item crosses as a CobolArg (carrier + the receiver's description) and the activated element passes its sending item's NumProfile / §8.5.1.12 layout, so the delivery is a content transfer under the one description a conforming pair shares, and a compatible group pair meets at CobolVarGroup.CorrespondingSpans. Documented residue: a NATIVE numeric receiver holds a value, so non-numeric content reads as the value ParseDisplay gives it (the same as every character view of a native cell).
